description: This file implements the remote cluster profile image sending service for Mattermost, including task management, HTTP request construction, and response handling.

classes.name: sendProfileImageTask
classes.description: Represents a task to send a user's profile image to a remote cluster, including target cluster info, user ID, provider, and callback.

classes.name: ProfileImageProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing profile images for users.

methods.name: SendProfileImage
methods.description: Asynchronously enqueues a task to send a user's profile image to a remote cluster.

methods.name: sendProfileImage
methods.description: Processes a sendProfileImageTask, sending the profile image and invoking callback if provided.

methods.name: sendProfileImageToRemote
methods.description: Performs the HTTP POST request to send the profile image to the remote cluster, handling response and errors.
